profile.ja: 五車学園の生徒。鬼族と人間のハーフで、赤子の頃に孤児院の軒先にこっそりと捨てられていた。角があり、年齢に見合わぬ怪力を持つ彼女を忌避する者は多かったが、子どもに恵まれなかった対魔忍夫婦が彼女を養子にして育ててくれた。髪留めの鈴飾りは、溢れ出る魔族の力を押さえつける封印具である。外して力を解放すれば更なる怪力を発揮できるが、一方で血に飢えた鬼の気性に心が囚われてしまい、敵味方の見境がなくなるリスクを孕んでいる。彼女は敵から負わされた身体的、精神的苦痛を対魔粒子に変換して体内に蓄積し、いざという時にその力を利用して自分の能力をブーストさせるカウンター型の忍法“怨讐転化”の使い手でもある。しかし、ダメージを蓄積することで心身に多大な負担をかけてしまう為、あまり多用は出来ない。戦闘になれば修羅の如き活躍を見せるもみじだが、本来は争いごとが苦手な性格で、たとえ敵であったとしても傷つけたくないと願っている。人見知り気味ではあるが、恩人や心を許した相手にはとことん尽くす義理固い性格。座右の銘は“倍返し”。任務で多忙な両親に代わり幼少期から炊事洗濯を任されていたため家事がうまく、お菓子作りも得意で、携行食代わりに用意している手作りのおはぎは仲間からも好評のようだ。
profile.en: She is a student at Gosha Academy. As a half-demon and half-human, she was abandoned at an orphanage when she was a baby. Many people shunned her due to her horns and extraordinary strength, which exceeded her age. However, a Taimanin couple who couldn't have children of their own adopted and raised her. The bell accessory on her hair tie is a seal that suppresses her demonic powers. If she removes it, she can unleash her full strength, but she risks being consumed by her demonic instincts and losing her sense of friend or foe. She can convert the physical and mental pain she suffers from her enemies into Taimanin particles, which she can accumulate in her body and use to boost her abilities when needed. However, this counter-type ninja art, "Vengeful Transformation," puts a significant burden on her mind and body, so she can't use it too much. Although she excels in combat, she is actually averse to conflict and doesn't want to hurt anyone, even if they are her enemies. She is a bit shy around people she doesn't know, but she is extremely loyal to those she considers her benefactors or those she has come to trust. Her motto is "returning favors." Since her parents were often busy with missions, she was in charge of household chores from a young age, which is why she is skilled at cooking and cleaning. She also enjoys making sweets and has prepared handmade ohagi for her comrades as a snack.

text.ja: 今日からお世話になる、皆瀬もみじです……本当に、私でいいの？　だって、私は――いや、いいや。受け入れてくれるなら、あなたに尽くすよ
text.en: Starting today, I'll be in your care - I'm Minase Momiji... Really, are you sure I'm okay? I mean, I'm not exactly... Never mind. If you're willing to accept me, I'll do my best to serve you.

text.ja: ……この頭、わかっちゃうよね。そう、鬼の血が入ってるの。どんな親だったのか、もうわからないけどね
text.en: ...You can tell, can't you? Yeah, I've got demon blood in me. I don't know what my real parents were like, but...

text.ja: いまの両親は、捨てられてた私を拾ってくれた、恩人……ううん……本当の、お父さんとお母さんだって思ってる
text.en: My current parents are the ones who picked me up when I was abandoned... No, they're my real parents. I think of them as my real mom and dad.

text.ja: お疲れさま……お茶、淹れてきたよ。あと、疲れてるなら、甘い物かと思って……よかったら、これ……おはぎ、得意なの
text.en: You must be tired... I've made some tea, and I thought you might like something sweet, so I've got some ohagi for you.

text.ja: あ、お疲れさま……うん、掃除中、だけど？　詰め所が汚れてたら、ゆっくり落ち着けないでしょ？　大丈夫、家事は得意だから
text.en: Ah, you're tired... Yeah, I'm in the middle of cleaning, but... If the quarters are dirty, you can't relax, right? Don't worry, I'm good at household chores.

text.ja: 戦闘か……大丈夫、ちゃんと戦うよ。みんなが傷つかないか、それが心配なだけ……封印具は、はずさないようにしないと……
text.en: Combat, huh... Don't worry, I'll fight. I just worry about everyone getting hurt... I have to be careful not to remove my seal...

text.ja: あの……今日、時間あるかな？　いつも、お世話になってるから……お返しに、食事でも……よかったら、家に寄っていって？
text.en: Um, do you have some time today? Since you're always taking care of me... I'd like to return the favor with a meal or something. Would you like to come over to my place?

text.ja: 好きな食べ物ある？　食べられないものは？　料理も得意だから、だいたいなんでも用意できるよ……うん、楽しみにしてて
text.en: Do you have a favorite food? Is there anything you can't eat? I'm good at cooking, so I can make almost anything... Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

text.ja: ……こんな関係になれるなんて、思ってもみなかったけど……ちゃんと知識はあるから。誠心誠意ご奉仕させてもらうね……よろしくお願いします
text.en: ...I never thought we'd end up in a relationship like this, but... I've got the knowledge, so I'll serve you with all my heart... Nice to meet you, I'm looking forward to it.

text.ja: ちゃんと、気持ちよくできてるかな……物足りなかったら、好きに動いてね。全部、受け止めるから……私の身体、好きに使っていいよ
text.en: ...I hope I'm doing this right... If it's not enough, feel free to do whatever you want. I'll take everything... You can use my body however you like.
